time_models.regression: Kampanie: 30 minut na krok; trzy buildy: 15 minut. To kroki testowe, nie czas przejścia.
time_models.pacing: Osobne tempo-kampanii: 10 sekund na próbę akcji, rzeczywiste timery i regeneracja; sesje ciągłe lub godzina dziennie.
time_models.personas: 48 godzin co 5 minut, z jawnymi limitowanymi symulowanymi zakupami premium botów.

limits: Automatyczne przejścia łączą formularze i zwykłe serwisy; osobny test Chromium sprawdza GUI.
Tempo kampanii jest modelem strategii wojownika, nie pomiarem czasu człowieka ani całego G2 NK.
Raport nie zastępuje testów współbieżności PostgreSQL ani publicznego hostingu.

initial_findings: Two ordinary build simulations failed by choosing a camp before the required prologue. Fixed by earning prologue and branch gates through forms.
Local HTTP policy test initially required permission to bind localhost; subsequently the full regression passed.
Cross-realm shop offers, missing disabled-button reasons and misleading colony labels in Khorinis.
Tall mobile character card; replaced with native responsive disclosure.

assessment.progression: All recorded campaign variants finish with earned resources and no defeated hunts; levels 26–31 and strength 240–310 in this warrior strategy.
assessment.pace: Funding equipment through contracts and earned consumables is faster than mining for each upgrade. Calendar-session models include offline recovery.
enjoyment_limits: Automatic combat and repeated contracts do not establish long-term enjoyment or retention.
Known-goal warrior scripts do not measure novice decision time or every build.
Current stories end before the missing G2 NK expansion; collection of every random rarity has no guaranteed completion time.
next_priorities: Implement #111/#30 safely before unlocking post-convergence content.
Expand #32 against an explicit original G2 NK reference index.
Use #31 to compare more build/session strategies before changing global rewards.
